= camel test agent run

Runs tests on the agent server

NOTE: This command is provided by the `test` plugin. Install it with `camel plugin add test`.


== Usage

[source,bash]
----
camel test agent run [options]
----



== Options

[cols="2,5,1,2",options="header"]
|===
| Option | Description | Default | Type
| `--async` | Run the tests asynchronously and poll the agent for the test results (see --polling-interval). |  | boolean
| `--background` | When enabled the command is not blocking for the test result response. |  | boolean
| `--dep` | Set of additional Maven dependencies that should be loaded with the agent. |  | String[]
| `--engine` | Name of the test engine that is used to run tests. One of junit, junit-jupiter, junit4, testng, cucumber |  | String
| `--includes` | Includes test name pattern. |  | String[]
| `--modules` | Comma delimited list of additional Citrus modules that should be loaded with the agent. |  | String
| `--packages` | Test package name to include in the test run. |  | String[]
| `--polling-interval` | Interval used to poll for test results. Only used in asynchronous test execution mode. | 2000 | String
| `--port` | Server port to connect to. |  | String
| `--property` | Default System property to set before the test run. |  | String[]
| `--reset` | Should the test engine reset the suite state for each run. | true | String
| `--test-jar` | Path to a Java archive that holds tests to run. |  | String
| `--timeout` | Http request timeout. | 60000 | String
| `--url` | Server endpoint URL to connect to. |  | String
| `--verbose` | Should the test engine print verbose test summary information. | true | String
| `--work-directory` | The working directory used by the file based test engines to load file resources from. |  | String
| `-h,--help` | Display the help and sub-commands |  | boolean
|===
